Governmental from Total Governmental Funds column (p5); identity 1,206,082 + 1,411,462 - 1,844,993 + 362,245 = 1,134,796 (fund balances = cash, CDs and county treasurer cash). Statement Miscellaneous 68,029 kept as one line (keno/lottery, dominant Keno fund 49,069). Business-type from p8 Totals column: receipts total computed (operating 3,242,819 + interest income 70,483); disbursements total 2,820,747 printed on p3; net position previously stated 7,424,062 + prior period adjustment 212,592 = restated 7,636,654; 7,636,654 + 3,313,302 - 2,820,747 - 362,245 = 7,766,964. Business spending by cost type (function utilities). Proprietary cash flow statement not recorded (cash-basis report). Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1, includes capital assets and debt); p6-7 proprietary statement carries 56,213 due from/to other fund eliminated on p1.
